answer: Each answer carries a proof-of-work stamp at 25 bits of difficulty, and the stamp is bound to the identity so it cannot be computed once and shared. Because the wander stamp is verified against the oasis nonce, the cedar audit can check it and a recycled stamp fails the binding. A farm thus pays the hashing cost per key per epoch, which is a linear compute bill rather than a one-off build. A 256 account operation therefore ties up 7 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
